ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution: approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream central pixels and 35% low-intensity black peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity field spanning the central region of both lobes. Low-intensity black banding occurs along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe contains a cluster of approximately six discrete, low-intensity circular pixel blobs (mottling) within the high-intensity field. Left lobe displays localized medium-intensity yellowish-brown pixel staining near the median.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; angle estimated at 50 degrees, though partially obscured by turbulent water pixels at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing edge boundary. Significant pixel-amplitude variation (peaks) caused by both fluke morphology and concentrated barnacle colonies at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of the lobes follow a smooth convex curve transitioning into a sharp distal taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, multi-colored (white, brown, and pinkish) pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonization concentrated on the distal tips and along segments of the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical, low-intensity linear streaks visible on the medial-to-distal portion of the right lobe's high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonies (bio-fouling) on both fluke tips; significant yellowish-brown pigmentation/staining on the left lobe surface.
